name: Python review baseline
description: Maintainability, typing, error handling, and testing guidance for Python services.

rules.title: Changed interfaces have clear contracts
rules.rationale: Explicit inputs, outputs, and failure behaviour reduce review ambiguity.
check_statements: Type information is preserved at important boundaries.

rules.title: Behaviour changes have focused tests
rules.rationale: Tests should demonstrate externally meaningful behaviour and failure paths.
check_statements: Changed behaviour is covered by a focused test.
